belief_statement: One possibility is that artists group session untrained has inconsistent effects on global local ratio saccade, but the evidence is limited (2 findings, 1 studies). Further research is needed.

mechanisms.pathway: artists group session untrained → [unknown mechanism] → global local ratio saccade

latent_variables.name: Individual sensitivity differences
latent_variables.rationale: High heterogeneity (high) across findings suggests an unmeasured individual-difference variable moderates the effect of artists group session untrained on global local ratio saccade.
latent_variables.suggested_measure: Pre-screening for trait sensitivity or prior exposure

latent_variables.name: Dose and duration
latent_variables.rationale: Most studies measure presence/absence of artists group session untrained, not dose-response curves. Duration and intensity likely matter.
latent_variables.suggested_measure: Parametric variation of intensity and exposure duration

research_needs.question: Does the effect of artists group session untrained on global local ratio saccade replicate in a pre-registered RCT?
